name: msds-inference-agent
description: Evidence-traceable MSDS inference and template-driven overwrite workflows that preserve S1/S3/S9 source facts, map them to the database-canonical 17-section skeleton, and gate formal Word/PDF output with retrieval and placeholder audits.

interface.shortDescription: Trace facts and produce audited template-based MSDS drafts
interface.longDescription: Builds a source-preserving facts package from Section 1, 3, and 9 inputs, records official-standard evidence, then uses the approved Word template overwrite path for controlled brand/language/format output. Formal output suppresses empty S9 rows, uses controlled S11/S12 evidence fallbacks, and requires readback audit.
defaultPrompt: Build a traceable database-canonical 17-section facts skeleton from this MSDS Excel form.
Preserve the original S1/S3/S9 values, search authoritative evidence, and flag conflicts or review-required fields.
Use the approved template overwrite workflow to produce an audited Word/PDF draft only after the input contract and evidence ledger pass validation.
